title: Recent advances in music generation: methods, evaluation, and challenges
reported_observation: The survey reviews representations, architectures, training, controllability and evaluation. Its abstract highlights semantic/temporal/symbolic mismatches, difficulty translating high-level conditions into stable fine-grained variation, and fragmented evaluation.
creator_interpretation: Supports separating consistency, controllability, musical quality, representation and evaluation in our research design.
our_hypothesis: Suno prompt effects may be entangled, coarse or context-dependent; community findings should be measured across separate musical dimensions and repeated generations.
limitations: Research capture summary, not a full audit of the source.
Community observations are self-reported unless otherwise specified.
Do not infer Suno's proprietary architecture from these observations.
